g.text: More features do not guarantee a better validation score
Temporal scope, 2015-2017 validation; equal annual weights; raw probabilities.
C: calendar/location; T: temperature; M: moisture. Night, region and history are added in order.
Onset includes 00 and 01 outcomes. These years were used for model selection; lines connect discrete feature sets.
